description:
## [0.0.22](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram/compare/v0.0.21...v0.0.22) (2026-11-22)

### Bug Fixes

* With `Glass tab bar` and `Show content behind the tab bar` on, a story you open no longer covers the whole screen for a moment before jumping up above the gesture bar. Reported in #618.
* Unticking Interested or Not interested in `Items in the three-dot menus` takes them off a suggested post's menu in Home again. Instagram 456 renamed those two rows there. Reported in #707.
* The time on a feed video's seek bar is smaller now and sits under the tags and sound buttons, so tapping it no longer opens the tags instead. Reported in #711.
* The dot beside a new setting stays until you've scrolled to it. Going back out of a page cleared every dot on it, even the ones further down you never saw. Reported in #689.
* `Show if a profile follows you` now labels profiles that have a name but no pronouns. The label and badges were only showing up on profiles with no name at all. Reported in #727.
* `Ambient light in stories` no longer flashes white bars on a light theme when a story opens or you swipe to the next one. The glow also stays on until the next story's is ready. Reported in #751.
* `Long press a profile picture to view it` works on accounts with an avatar too. Their picture turns between the photo and the avatar, and a long press there used to open Instagram's avatar card instead of the picture. Reported in #758.
* Posts with several photos and a song keep their seek bar in the reels viewer now, the same as a single photo with a song. Reported in #10.
* `See-through top bar` fades out below the header now, instead of stopping on a hard line when you scroll back up. Reported in #462.
* Home no longer crashes when a hide switch removes the only post on a page of the feed, which could happen when opening a link to a post.
* With `Ask for VP9 instead of AV1` on, a post or reel Instagram still sends as AV1 saves as VP9 from its website when one's there. HushGram asks logged out. Stories can still come as AV1. Reported in #546.
* Letting go after `Hold for 2x on feed videos` no longer pauses the video when `Tap a feed video to pause it` is on too.
* The tags and sound buttons on feed videos move up above the seek bar while it shows, carousel videos' sound button too, so they don't cover its ends. The toggle sits beside them. Reported in #794.
* An exported settings file now keeps `Time on the seek bar` and `Show the time left` for feed videos too.
* The `Show if a profile follows you` label no longer lands on top of the post count on profiles with no name.
* `Glass in chats` keeps the message bar's glass when Instagram switches the bar to its newer layout, and `Message bar tint` works on it again. Reported in #759.
* Messages in a chat no longer jump and snap back while you type a long message with `Glass in chats` on. Reported in #757.
* `Fill the screen` goes grey with a line saying why while `Show the whole reel` is on, since that switch wins and reels kept their side bars. Reported in #755.
* `Hide captions` no longer leaves an empty gap under the username on reels. The username row moves down into the caption's room. Reported in #680.
* The seek bar on reels no longer sits under the floating tab bar after you come back from picture in picture. Reported in #450.
* With the tab bar hiding on Reels, dragging a reel's seek bar no longer leaves it sitting on top of the caption once you let go. Reported in #450.
* Logging in with Facebook no longer stops on Facebook's "link may be broken" page and a spinner that never ends. The Facebook app turns away a patched Instagram, so the login goes through your browser now. Reported in #760.
* Reels that run behind the glass tab bar sit where they should again instead of up against the top of the screen with a black band under them. Reported in #763.
* Unfolding a foldable with `Glass tab bar` on keeps every tab in Instagram's side rail now, lined up. Search and your profile used to go missing from it and the rest sat out of line. Reported in #764.
* `Thicker story progress bar` thickens the bar again with a seek bar shape picked. 0.0.21 left a shaped bar as thin as before. Now its line grows like the standard bar's, and the waves keep their size. Reported in #775.
* With `Taps on feed videos stay in the feed` on, tapping a feed video no longer stops it on its cover or leaves it under a play button. Instagram set the video up for Reels before HushGram caught the tap. Reported in #706.
* `Sent follow requests` now catches the Requested button at the top of a profile. Since 456 Instagram sets that button another way, so a request you sent from someone's profile never made it onto the list. Reported in #690.
* `Text size` stays put when you turn your phone or change one of its settings. Captions in the feed went back to your phone's own size after that, until Instagram was closed and opened again. Reported in #782.
* Signing in no longer closes Instagram on a phone without Google Play services, like a de-Googled ROM or one running microG. `Run without Play services` is on by default and has no switch. Reported in #767 and #748.
* On a narrow phone, HushGram's buttons at the top of a chat fold into one More button that holds all of them, so the chat's name shows and the last call button isn't cut off. Reported in #802.
* Bigger text from Text size no longer makes a chat's message box taller. The space around the text shrinks first, and only then does the box's text come down a little, still bigger than the phone's size. Reported in #806.
* `See who a story mentions` brings its list back after you watch the story of a profile you opened from it. Watching that story still closed the list, so going back to the first story left it shut. Reported in #403.
* The Lens button on reels and stories sees the video now instead of a black box. Instagram plays some videos on a layer of its own, which HushGram reads now for Lens and the glass tab bar. Reported in #801 and #583.
* Tap download on more than three things at once and the extra ones wait their turn instead of failing with Download failed. The toasts say whose media it is now, like "Saving from @name...". Asked for in #792.
* With `Pure black dark mode`, the little bars that pop up at the bottom (Link copied, Saved and the like) are black now too. They stayed dark gray. Asked for in #816.
* With `See-through top bar` and the glass tab bar both on, the stories row on Home gets the header's glass shine too, so it no longer sits there as a black band between the glass and the posts. Asked for in #800.
* `Hide Suggested for you on follow lists` keeps the suggested people off both Follow requests screens now, the old one and the newer page Notifications opens, even when Instagram sends them anyway. Reported in #814.
* `Find the reel you came from` works for reels in your feed too. Tap the name on a reel in Home, open their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel. Before, only the Reels viewer did this. Reported in #795.
* With the wave `Seek bar shape`, the story you're watching no longer shows Instagram's straight bar running under the wave. The straight part now starts where the wave ends. Reported in #796.
* `Ambient light` now glows around photo and carousel reels and reels Instagram plays on its own video layer, and fills the thin black bars above and below a reel. `Rounded corners on Reels` rounds photo reels too. Reported in #796.
* With `Keep 2x after you let go`, the name over a feed video comes back when you let go, and the time readout goes away. Before, they stayed the way they look while you hold. Reported in #552.
* With `Classic colors` or `Backgrounds in the accent color` on, an open chat takes your page color behind the messages and in its header instead of staying black. Chats with a theme of their own keep it. Reported in #528.
* The Messages list keeps your page color when Instagram opens straight into it from a notification. Its rows stayed black until a restart. Reported in #528.
* With `Glass in chats` on, messages no longer jump up and down as a chat opens or the message bar changes height, and the newest one no longer ends up hidden behind the bar. Reported in #528.

### Improvements

* `Blur the chat behind a held message` is new under Messages. Press and hold a message and the rest of the chat blurs behind it, so the message and its reactions stand out. Needs Android 12 or newer. Starts off. Asked for in #684.
* `Glass buttons in chats` is new under `Glass in chats`. Turn it off and the buttons at the top of a chat lose their round glass, leaving a plain blur behind them like Instagram's own. Asked for in #684.
* `Even on silent` is new under `Start feed videos with sound`. With your phone on silent or vibrate, Home's videos still start with their sound, as long as the media volume is up. Starts off. Asked for in #762.
* `Record calls` is new under Messages. A Record button saves both sides of a call to your Recordings folder (Music on Android 11 or older) and stops when the call ends. Some places require everyone's consent. Starts off. Asked for in #732.
* `Chat bubbles` is new under Notifications. A chat's notification gets Android's bubble button, so the chat can float over other apps. Hidden and locked chats never get one. Needs Android 11 or newer. Starts off. Asked for in #747.
* Press and hold a collection in Saved to lock it or take its lock off, with no trip to settings. Taking a lock off always asks first, the same way your other locks unlock, even with the collection open. Asked for in #678.
* Posts and reels saved into a locked collection now stay out of Saved's All, Posts, Reels and search while it's locked, and its tile hides its cover. They come back after an unlock once Saved refreshes. Asked for in #678.
* `Center names in chats` is new under Messages. The name at the top of a chat sits in the middle, as close as the call buttons allow. Starts off. `Ask before a call` moved to Manager's Interaction group. Asked for in #779.
* `Pinch for clear mode` is new under Reels. Pinching a reel toggles clear mode. `Hide the exit button in clear mode` hides its round button. `Pinch to zoom` wins when on. Both start off. Requested in #744.
* `Let the screen sleep when a reel stops` is new under Reels. With this on, a paused reel lets your phone's screen timeout run. Starts off. `Control the reel above comments` moved to Manager's Comments group. Asked for in #777.
* `Expand captions on reels` is new under Reels and comes with `Expand captions`. Reels show their whole caption. It's separate from the feed one, since a long caption covers more of the video. Starts off. Asked for in #752.
* `Hide Threads posts` is new under Reels, right after `Hide stories in Reels`. It takes out the cards Instagram slips between reels to get you onto Threads. Every reel still plays. Starts off. Asked for in #765.
* `Hide Not interested and Interested` is new under Reels and takes those two buttons off a reel. `Hide 'Are you interested?' bubbles` now covers Home only. If you had it on, the Reels one starts on too. Asked for in #769.
* `Stop swipe to Messages` is new under Feed, after `Stop swipe to create`. On the classic tab bar, a swipe left on Home no longer slides Messages in. The Messages button still works. Starts off. Asked for in #770.
* `Expand captions` is new under Feed. Feed posts show their whole caption. `Caption lines before more` sets a number of lines instead, from one to ten. Stories keep short captions. Starts off. Requested in #771.
* `Hide the line under names` is new under Feed. It clears the song, place and labels under a post's name. `Hide the line under names on reels` covers Reels. Sponsored labels stay. Both start off. Requested in #771.
* `Keep the place` goes with `Hide the line under names`. A post's place stays on that line by itself, so it sits still instead of taking turns with the song. Asked for in #771.
* `Only after a long hold` goes under `Keep 2x after you let go`. A quick hold to peek at 2x goes back to normal speed when you let go, and a hold of about 3 seconds keeps 2x. Asked for in #552.
* `Keep the name while you hold` goes under `Hold for 2x on feed videos`. The name over a feed video stays while you hold it at 2x, and Instagram's 2x and time labels stay off. Asked for in #552.
* `Hide Followers and Following on profiles` is new under Profiles. `Hide follower counts` takes the numbers off and leaves the words. `Hide Followers and Following` takes both buttons away and closes the gap. Both start off. Requested in #771.
* `Read messages without the seen receipt` gets a switch, `Mark a chat seen when you react`. Reacting to something someone sent lets them see you read up to it, and anything newer stays unseen. Starts off. Requested in #772.
* The viewing history page has a grid button next to Clear. It shows what you watched as big covers, three across. Tap it again for the list. The page remembers your pick. Requested in #773.
* `Auto scroll in the reel menu` under Reels puts Turn on auto scroll or Turn off auto scroll in a reel's three-dot menu. It works on accounts where Instagram doesn't offer auto scroll too. Requested in #768.
* `Hide notifications by type` under Notifications lists the kinds of notifications Instagram has sent you, each with a line from one, and takes the ones you tick off the page. Requested in #756.
* Saving a reel gets its picture and sound at the same time now, instead of one after the other, so saves finish sooner. Asked about in #493.
* A feed post's three-dot menu can now show Block and Playback speed. Turn on `Block in a post's menu` and `Speed in a post's menu` under Downloads. Requested in #743.
* `Items in the three-dot menus` under Feed has five more to untick. A reel's menu can drop Remix and sequence, Use as reference, Use template and Get Edits, and `Loop this video` can come off reel and feed video menus. Asked for in #707.
* `Items in the three-dot menus` has more to untick: Save, the Download rows, Details, About this account, Block, Hide posts from this account, Loop this story and Add to Stories priority, story menus included. Asked for in #707.
* Press and hold the Download button on a story to pick `Download` or `Save all`, which saves every story in the set you're watching. It comes with `Download button on stories`. Requested in #745.
* Under `Default playback quality` there's a new `Drop quality to keep playing` switch. It's on to start, so a slow connection drops a rung instead of stalling. Turn it off to keep the quality you picked. Requested in #761.
* Two new switches under Feed, next to `Hide the Like button`. `Hide counts on posts` takes the like, comment, share and repost numbers off feed posts and keeps the buttons. `Hide Liked by` takes the "Liked by" line off them. Asked for in #762.
* `Hide the tag icon on posts` sits right under `Hide the audio icon on posts` in Feed. It takes the little person icon off posts with people tagged in them, and product tags keep theirs. Also from #762.
* `Hide the empty profile prompt` is new in Profiles, under `Hide the Create button`. While your profile has no posts, it takes the big "first post" prompt off your grid. Other people's empty profiles don't change. Asked for in #762.
* Two new switches follow `Hide suggested accounts in Messages`. `Hide the New message button` takes the pencil off your messages. `Hide suggestions in New message` drops Suggested people from the New message and new group screens, and search still works. Asked for in #762.
* The Saved bookmark on your profile now opens the menu's Saved page, starting on All with a back arrow, instead of the grid of collections. Accounts Instagram hasn't given that page yet still get the grid. Asked for in #762.
* `Hide the New collection button` sits under `Fast scroll in Saved` in Profiles. It takes the + off the top of Saved, on both Saved screens, and your collections stay where they are. No restart needed. Also from #762.
* `Hide the Reels tab in Saved` and `Hide Saved on the Search tab` are new under `Hide the New collection button`. Saved reels still show under All, and the Search tab change needs a restart. Asked for in #810.
* Two more switches under Comments. `Hide likes on comments` takes the heart and like count off every comment. `Hide the comment box` takes away the box at the bottom, so the comments get that space. Asked for in #762.
* Tap to play's `Where videos wait` can treat Explore on its own now, with four new picks, `Everywhere but Explore`, `Only in Explore`, `Reels and Explore` and `Everywhere but Reels and Explore`. Reels opened from Explore count as Reels. Asked for in #762.
* The video under the HushGram settings pauses while they're open, so it stops playing and loading where you can't see it. Closing the settings plays it again, and a video you'd tapped with Tap to play on stays tapped. Asked for in #762.
* `Light settings page` sits under `Black settings page` in Settings entry. It turns the HushGram settings and the pages they open white, with dark text and status bar icons. The rest of Instagram keeps its own look. Asked for in #762.
* A song's page, the one you reach by tapping a reel's song, has a Download icon beside Save now. It saves the whole song as audio, like `Download full song` in a reel's menu, and follows that switch. Asked for in #741.
* `Find the reel you came from` labels the reel it finds with You just watched, over a dimmed tile with a colored edge, for a few seconds. The old white outline was easy to miss. Asked for in #781.
* `Hide reels with few views` adds limits for maximum views, likes and comments per 1,000 views, length and age, plus `Newest first` and `Also on Home`. 0 means off. Reels from accounts you follow still play. Asked for in #780.
* A chat's clock button menu has `Select messages` now, under Export chat. Tick loaded messages, then copy, share or save them to a text file in Downloads. It comes with `Export a chat as text`. Asked for in #778.
* In Manager's Expert mode the six comment patches have a Comments group of their own now, like the Comments page in HushGram settings, and `HushGram launch screen` moved to Settings. Interaction and Interface were getting too long to scan.
* `Keep the tab bar on reel links` is new under Interaction, with its switch in Reels settings. A reel link from another app, like WhatsApp, plays on your current tab with the tab bar under it. Starts off. Asked for in #385.
* `Blocked words` under `Hide reels by caption words` takes an @name too, like `@cnn`. That account's reels leave the Reels tab, and with `Also on Home` on its posts leave Home as well. Asked for in #807.
* `Also in comments` is new under `Hide reels by caption words`. It hides comments that hold a word from your list, and comments by an account the list names with @. Replies to a hidden comment go with it. Asked for in #807.
* `Also in search`, new under `Hide reels by caption words`, takes a row out of the Explore grid and search results when a post in it matches your list, by its words or its account. Asked for in #807.
* `Swipe through a chat's reels` works in chats where you have a Blend with the person too. Swiping up goes through the reels shared in the chat first, and the Blend's reels come after them. Asked for in #804.
* The `Blocked words` row under `Hide reels by caption words` now says how much your list has hidden, in the last 24 hours and in all, counting reels, Home posts and comments. Asked for in #807.
* `Instagram settings page` is new under `Settings entry`. HushGram's settings look like Instagram's own, with plain rows, gray section names and its round switch, in dark or light to match. It wins over the Black and Light looks. Asked for in #797.
* `Don't open reels from chats` is new under Messages. A reel someone shares in a chat stays closed when you tap it, and a short note says reels from chats are off. Photos, videos and shared posts still open. Asked for in #810.
* `Reels on Home below the name` is new under Feed. Reels on Home show like other posts, with the name and three-dot menu above the video instead of on it. Live videos and other reels keep Instagram's layout. Asked for in #788.
* `Time on the seek bar` is new under `Seek bar on stories`. It shows the time played and the story's length, like 0:03 / 0:15, and a tap (or `Show the time left`) counts down instead. Asked for in #784.
* `Copy text in the story menu` is new under Stories. Copy text in a story's three-dot menu copies the words Instagram read in the picture, or opens Google Lens when it found none. Starts off. Asked for in #789.
* `Full-size Reels icon` is new under Tab bar. Instagram's Reels icon is narrower than the others, so it looks small. This draws it a bit bigger to match, on top of your Tab icon size. Starts off. Asked for in #793.
* **Tooling:** The GitHub release notes leave out the Tooling bullets and the What was checked part now. They're still here in the changelog, and Manager's notes keep their Validation line.
* **Tooling:** Each patch test area starts a fresh test JVM every 10 classes. A fingerprint keeps its last match, so one JVM per area held every fixture build it patched and ran out of heap.

### Validation

Validation: 12787 runtime tests passed locally. All 3389 patch tests passed too.

patches.name: Accent color
patches.description: Swaps Instagram's blue on Follow buttons, links and other highlights for purple, pink, red, orange, green, teal or your wallpaper's colors (Material You, on Android 12 and newer). Its `Classic colors` switch brings back Instagram's older look, with a navy dark mode, charcoal gray panels and an off-white light mode, and it works with the accent off too. Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Lets you take screenshots and record your screen where Instagram normally blocks it, such as disappearing photos and videos in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Ambient light
patches.description: Puts a soft glow in a post's own colors around its photo or video in Home and Following, and in the bands around a reel that doesn't fill the screen. The glow follows a video as it plays, and you pick how far it spreads and how fast it changes. A second switch fills the bands above and below a story that doesn't fill the screen. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed and Stories.

patches.name: App-only proxy
patches.description: Sends Instagram through an HTTP proxy you set, without changing the proxy for other apps or the phone. You need to set a server too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Ask before a call
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before a call starts from a chat, so a stray tap on the call button doesn't ring anyone, and can take the call buttons, Blend and the back arrow off the top of a chat. All start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Ask before a follow
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before a Follow or Follow back button follows someone or sends them a request, so a stray tap on a profile or in a Followers or Following list doesn't do it for you. A second switch skips Instagram's "Review this account before following" sheet, so one tap follows. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Ask before a like
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before the Like button under a post, on a reel or on a comment likes or unlikes it, so a stray tap doesn't do it for you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Ask before a refresh
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before pulling down, or tapping the tab you're on again, refreshes Home, Reels or another list, so an accidental pull or tap doesn't replace what you were reading. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Ask for VP9 instead of AV1
patches.description: Tells Instagram your phone has no AV1 decoder, which takes a restart. A post or reel that still comes as AV1 is saved as VP9 from Instagram's website when it offers one. Stories can still be AV1, and Convert to keep the full size turns those into H.264. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Auto scroll in Home
patches.description: Moves Home on to the next post by itself. A video moves on when it ends, a photo or carousel after the time you pick. Touching the screen holds it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Back leaves Home
patches.description: Makes Back on Home leave Instagram at once, instead of first scrolling the feed to the top and reloading it or saying "Tap again to exit". Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Blur the bars around Reels
patches.description: Shows a blurred copy of a reel above and below it, or beside it, where Instagram would leave black bars. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Call blocker
patches.description: Lets you choose who can ring your phone with an Instagram call: everyone, nobody, only people on your list, or everyone except them. A stopped call just goes unanswered for the caller. Everyone to start. Change it in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Carousel arrows
patches.description: Puts a back and a next arrow on a post's carousel in Home and Following, so a tap moves to the next photo or video without a swipe, can move its page dots onto a round pill over the photo, and can take away the page number like 3/5. The pill can be solid, see-through or frosted glass. All of them start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Center names in chats
patches.description: Puts the name and username at the top of a chat in the middle of the bar, or as near the middle as the call buttons leave room for. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Change the like animation
patches.description: Lets you pick the animation that plays when you double tap a post to like it. The choices are animations Instagram made for its Rings creators. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Change version code
patches.description: Stops Google Play from offering Meta's updates over your patched Instagram. Going back to the normal Instagram later means uninstalling first, which deletes its data. Later HushGram builds need this patch too. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Chat bubbles
patches.description: Lets a chat's message notification open as an Android bubble that floats over other apps (Android 11 or newer). Hidden and locked chats never get one. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Chat history tools
patches.description: Tap the clock button at the top of a chat, or long press its name, to jump to its first message or to a date, or to save the chat as a text file. Select messages there ticks messages to copy, share or save. The chat loads its older messages on its own, with a count and a Cancel button. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Chat plus menu
patches.description: Lets you take Saved, AI images and Draw off the plus menu in a chat's message bar, and move the gallery and microphone buttons into that menu. Starts with every switch off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Clean up Reels
patches.description: Hides extra buttons and prompts on reels, such as Follow, Edits, templates, Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta glasses, friends' activity, the Add a comment bar, the reply bar on reels from chats, the Like, Comment, Save and More buttons, the count under any of the buttons beside a reel, the pause icon on a paused reel, the Create and Your algorithm buttons, the Friends tab and the Reels tab's top bar. Each one has its own switch, and Burn-in guard can dim a reel's buttons, and a story's, while you aren't touching the screen. Keep clear mode on carries Instagram's clear mode to the next reels, and can start every reel in it. Pinch for clear mode turns clear mode on and off with two fingers, and can hide the button that leaves it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Clear the media cache
patches.description: Frees storage by deleting Instagram's saved copies of photos and videos once they pass a size you pick, 500 MB to start. Your sign-in, drafts and settings stay. A row shows how much they take up and clears them right away. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Storage.

patches.name: Control taps and volume on Reels
patches.description: Lets you choose what a single tap on a reel does: Instagram's default, pause, mute, or keep playing. Can also keep a reel muted when you press volume up. Both start at Instagram's behavior. Choose them in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Control the reel above comments
patches.description: With a reel's comments open, a tap on the reel above them pauses or plays it and a hold plays it at 2x, and the comments stay open. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Copy comment
patches.description: Adds Copy and Copy username to the menu you get on a comment, so you can copy its text or the commenter's username. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Copy links from chat buttons
patches.description: Adds Copy link to the menu you get when you hold a chat message with link buttons, like the ones automated accounts send. It copies where a button goes without opening it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Data saver
patches.description: Saves mobile data by loading smaller photos and starting videos at the lowest quality. It uses Full resolution photos and Default playback quality, so it turns both on. It starts with mobile data only. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Default playback quality
patches.description: Plays videos, reels and video stories at the quality you choose, instead of the one Instagram picks as it plays. When your connection can't keep up, a video drops to the next lower quality instead of stalling, unless you turn off Drop quality to keep playing. Nothing changes until you pick a quality. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Don't report Blend visits
patches.description: Stops Instagram from telling a chat that you opened its Blend. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Don't report screenshots
patches.description: Stops Instagram from telling people when you take a screenshot of their disappearing photo or video. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Don't save recent searches
patches.description: Keeps the accounts and tags you open from search out of your Recent list. Searches already in Recent stay until you clear them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches.name: Don't send feed view history
patches.description: Stops Instagram from learning which posts in Home you looked at and for how long. Posts you've already seen may come back. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Don't send reel watch history
patches.description: Stops Instagram from learning which reels you watched and how far you got. Reels you've already watched may come back. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Double tap to skip on Reels
patches.description: A double tap on the left side of a reel goes back 10 seconds and on the right side goes ahead 10 seconds, with Instagram's own skip. A double tap in the middle still likes it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Download any reel
patches.description: Adds Download to the menu of every reel and saves it without Instagram's watermark. You choose the quality, and best is the default. A separate Download cover switch also saves the reel's cover picture, the largest one the post carries, and Download audio saves just its sound. Download full song grabs the whole track when a reel uses a song from Instagram's music, and from a Download icon on that song's own page. Download as video on a carousel with music saves every page, in order. A separate switch under Downloads puts a download icon under Save beside each reel, and others add a Lens icon for copying a reel's text, a speed icon, a Full screen icon and a speaker icon, or put Playback speed in a reel's menu. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Download any story
patches.description: Adds Download to the menu of anyone's story. Videos save at the quality you choose and photos at their largest size, and Download as photo saves a still from a video story. A Download button at the top of a story is a separate switch, off to start, and so is a Copy text button that opens Google Lens on the story. Another switch puts Copy text in the menu, copying the words Instagram read in the picture. Turn them on or off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Download any video
patches.description: Adds Download to video posts in your feed, saving the video without Instagram's watermark. Other switches add Download for photos, Download cover, a Details row with the post's time and poster, a download icon beside Save under each post, and Hold to download, which saves a post or reel you hold two fingers on. Download all waits its turn, with up to ten posts queued, so two posts' pages never mix in your gallery. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Download voice messages
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu you get when you hold a voice message in a chat. It saves the recording as an audio file. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Emoji style
patches.description: Shows every emoji in Google's style instead of your phone's own, or in a free emoji pack (Twemoji, OpenMoji, Blobmoji) or a color emoji font file you pick. The full change shows after you restart Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Expand captions
patches.description: Shows the whole caption on posts in your feed, or as many lines as you pick, before "more", and on a switch of its own the whole caption on reels. Stories stay as they are. Starts off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed and Reels.

patches.name: Explore without personalization
patches.description: Opens Explore on the grid that isn't personalized every time and keeps it from switching back after ten minutes. Instagram only promises that grid in the EU. A second switch hides the EU menu button for it. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches.name: Find the reel you came from
patches.description: Open a creator's profile from a reel, then their Reels tab, and it scrolls to that reel and labels it You just watched for a few seconds. A photo reel is found in their posts. Stop looking ends the search, and Wait for a tap to find it holds it until you tap Find the reel. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Font
patches.description: Lets you pick the font Instagram's text uses: Instagram's own, your phone's, or a .ttf or .otf file. Restart Instagram to see a change. Starts on Instagram's font. Pick one in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Full resolution photos
patches.description: Loads photos in the largest size Instagram sends instead of one picked for your screen. A second switch asks for a larger size on screens under 1440 pixels wide, and a third gets reel covers and grid pictures at full size. Uses more data. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Full screen Reels and Home
patches.description: Hides the status bar and the navigation bar while Reels shows, and optionally on Home, your messages, stories, Explore or your profile. Swipe in from the edge to bring them back for a moment. Back and the keyboard work as usual. It can also show stories over the whole screen on tall phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels (Full screen Reels), Feed (Full screen Home), Messages (Full screen Messages), Stories (Full screen stories, Stories fill the screen), Explore (Full screen Explore) and Profiles (Full screen profile).

patches.name: Glass in chats
patches.description: Gives a chat's top bar and message bar frosted glass that blurs the messages under them (Android 12 and newer) and puts the back, call and video buttons on round glass circles. `Glass top bar in chats` under it leaves the top bar plain while the buttons and message bar keep their glass. Another switch gives the reply box on other people's stories the same glass. Starts off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages and Stories.

patches.name: Glass tab bar
patches.description: Draws the tab bar as a floating, rounded pill of frosted glass that blurs what's behind it (Android 12 and newer), with a highlight on the tab you're on. Content can optionally run down behind it. With the liquid look off, `Shrink the pill as you scroll` makes the pill smaller while you scroll down, and `Material look` makes it a solid pill in your phone's colors. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Tab bar, then restart Instagram.

patches.name: Group Instagram's notifications
patches.description: Puts Instagram's notifications in one group, or in a group for each type, so they don't fill your notification shade. Tapping one still opens it. You can also mute the types you pick, like promo pushes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Hide AI-labeled reels
patches.description: Leaves out reels that carry Instagram's own AI label. A reel without that label stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide Follow on feed posts
patches.description: Takes the Follow and Subscribe buttons off the top of posts in your feed. The name, time and menu stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide Follow on stories
patches.description: Takes the Follow button off the top of stories from accounts you don't follow. The name, time and menu stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Hide Followers and Following on profiles
patches.description: Takes the Followers and Following buttons, or just their numbers, off the top of profiles. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide GIFs in comments
patches.description: Takes GIFs and stickers out of comments, and the GIF button off the comment box. A comment with words keeps them. One that's only a GIF goes, along with its replies. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Hide Instagram Plus prompts
patches.description: Takes Instagram's offers to try Plus out of chats, stories and menus. Nothing that comes with Plus is turned on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Hide Instants
patches.description: Takes the stack of Instants out of your messages. Instants is Instagram's no-edit camera for sharing quick photos with friends. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide Made with Edits
patches.description: Takes the "Made with Edits" label out of the line under the author of posts in your feed. The song, the place and the other labels keep taking turns there. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide Meta AI
patches.description: Removes Meta AI from Instagram's search bars, messages, home top bar, reels menus, share sheet, stories and feed, and its restyle credits from stories and reels. Each part has its own switch. The search one and the Meta AI posts one start on, the rest start off. Change them in HushGram settings > Meta AI.

patches.name: Hide New message button and suggestions
patches.description: Takes the New message button off the top of your messages, and the Suggested people off the New message screen. Search still works. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide Notes on profile pictures
patches.description: Takes the Notes bubble off profile pictures, yours included. Notes in Messages stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide Reels in the feed
patches.description: Removes the rows of suggested reels from your home feed. A reel posted by someone you follow stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide activity bubbles
patches.description: Takes the little round pictures off posts and reels that show a friend liked, commented on or reshared them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Hides sponsored posts, reels, stories and the ad in comments, and leaves no gap where an ad would have been. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Hide captions
patches.description: Takes the caption off posts in your feed and off reels. The post stays, and the comments sheet still shows it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide comments
patches.description: Takes the Comment button and the comment count off posts in your feed. Other switches take Reply, the heart and like count, or AI labels off each comment, and the comment box, its gift button, the Meta AI search suggestion or the (i) button off the comments. All start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Hide group buttons on the share sheet
patches.description: Takes the New group button and the button that sends to several people as a group off the share sheet, and lets you pick which of the round buttons under the people it shows and hide its search bar. It can also fill the row of people a long press on Share opens. You can still start a group from your messages. All start off. Find them in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches.name: Hide highlights
patches.description: Takes the row of story highlights off profiles, yours and other people's. Bios, counts and posts stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide lives in Reels
patches.description: Leaves out the live broadcasts Instagram puts between reels in the Reels tab and when you swipe through reels from Explore. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide paid partnership Reels
patches.description: Leaves out reels with a Paid partnership label, and reels Instagram marks as boosted. Ads have their own switch. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide posts when you block someone
patches.description: Takes the posts of someone you block out of Home right away, instead of after you refresh it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide profile banners
patches.description: Adds switches that take the Threads badge, Facebook and WhatsApp links, the profile song, interests, channel invites, the row of links and other banners from under the bio on other people's profiles. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide profile tabs
patches.description: Lets you take the Subscriptions, Reels, Reposts and Tagged tabs off profiles, yours and other people's, and keep the grid. Starts with every tab showing. Pick which to hide in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide reels by caption words
patches.description: Leaves out reels whose caption holds a word or phrase from your list, or is in a language you don't keep. Also on Home does the same for Home's posts, Also in comments hides matching comments, and Also in search takes matching rows out of the Explore grid and search results. Starts off. Turn it on and type the words or languages in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide reels with few views
patches.description: Leaves out reels in the Reels tab outside numbers you pick: views, likes, comments, shares, saves, likes and comments per 1,000 views, video length and age. Can put reels newest first. Accounts you follow stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide reels you've seen
patches.description: Leaves reels you've already watched out of the Reels tab when Instagram shows them again. Reels you open from a profile or a chat still play. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide rows in Instagram's settings
patches.description: Lets you take the rows you don't use off Instagram's own Settings and activity screen. Open that screen once, then untick rows in HushGram settings > Layout > Rows in Instagram's settings. Every row shows to start.

patches.name: Hide suggested accounts in DMs
patches.description: Takes the Accounts to follow section off the bottom of your messages, and More suggestions out of Messages search. Your chats and follow requests stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide suggested accounts in Reels
patches.description: Leaves out the cards of accounts to follow that Instagram puts between reels, and on switches of their own its Catch up with friends pages of stories and its Threads cards. Every reel still plays. Starts off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide suggested people on profiles
patches.description: Takes Suggested for you and the Discover people button off profiles. Bios, counts and posts stay. More switches take Suggested for you off the follow lists, their Suggested tab and the Follow requests screen, Suggested subscriptions and the Discover people button off your own follow lists, the Complete your profile cards off your own profile, and People you don't follow back, suggested threads and people, and the Featured section off your notifications. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide suggested posts
patches.description: Removes posts from accounts you don't follow, suggested accounts, surveys and shopping rows from Home. It also takes shop tiles out of Explore and the shopping bag off posts with tagged products. Posts from accounts you follow stay. Extra switches can also hide the 'Are you interested in this post?' question on Home and Reels, the caught up card, the Join bar on channel posts, rows of stories about to expire, all videos, photos, carousels, posts you've liked, posts from business and creator accounts or posts from accounts you pick. A post's menu has Hide posts from this account to add one to that list, and those posts leave Home on the next refresh. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide suggested stories
patches.description: Removes stories from accounts you don't follow from the row at the top of Home. More switches hide rewinds and memories, keep only verified or unverified accounts, or hide the whole row. Starts on. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Hide that you're typing
patches.description: Stops the people you're chatting with from seeing when you're typing. You still see when they type. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide the 2x popup on Reels
patches.description: Takes the 2x label off a reel while you hold it to play faster. A second switch hides the message Instagram shows when you lock a reel's speed. The speed-up and the lock still work. Starts off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Hide the Community Standards reminder
patches.description: Takes the banner reminding you to be respectful off the bottom of a chat. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide the Explore grid
patches.description: Empties the grid of posts and reels on the Search tab. Search, recent searches and results stay. Two more switches hide the suggested accounts that show when you tap the search bar and the You may also like posts below search results. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches.name: Hide the Reels tab
patches.description: Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar. Reels in your feed and reels people send you still open. A second switch, Show the Reels tab, puts it back after Home when Instagram built your bar without one, and Hide wins if both are on. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels. Under Tab bar, switches do the same for Home, Search, Create, Messages and Profile, one takes the unread count off the Messages button, two put Messages or Activity on the bar when Instagram left them off, switches take the Create and notifications buttons off Home's header, others add a Search, Messages, Ghost mode or menu button to it or put Instagram's logo in its middle, two center the name at the top of profiles and the title on other screens, a list puts the tabs in your order, and another picks the tab Instagram opens on.

patches.name: Hide the Repost button
patches.description: Takes the Repost button and its count off posts and reels, so nothing gets reposted by mistake. Share still works. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches.name: Hide the Share button
patches.description: Takes the Share button and its count off posts in your feed and off reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Sharing.

patches.name: Hide the Threads button
patches.description: Takes the Threads button off the top of profiles, with switches for the Create button, Share profile and the empty profile prompt on your own, and Subscribe and the arrow after the buttons on creators' profiles. The menu and the other buttons stay. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Hide the audio icon on posts
patches.description: Takes the speaker icon off videos in your feed. Tapping the video still turns the sound on or off. A second switch takes the tagged people icon off posts too. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide the comment emoji row
patches.description: Takes the row of quick emoji off above the comment box. The box itself stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Hide the home feed
patches.description: Empties your home feed on purpose, so Home shows only the stories row. Profiles, Explore and Reels still show posts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Hide the line under names
patches.description: Takes the song, the place and the other labels off the line under the name on posts in your feed and on reels. Sponsored and Paid partnership stay, and `Keep the place` can leave a post's place there on its own. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed and Reels.

patches.name: Hide the notes row
patches.description: Takes the row of notes, and the Map bubble in it, off the top of your messages. Your chats stay. A second switch takes only the Map bubble. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide the reply box on stories
patches.description: Takes the Send message box off the bottom of other people's stories. The like and share buttons next to it stay where they are. Switches of their own take the Like, Comment and Share buttons off too, with no empty space left behind, and the comments floating over stories. A choice lifts the line for writing a comment. All start off. Set them in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Hide the search bar in Messages
patches.description: Takes the search bar and its Filter button off the top of your messages, the Meta AI bar too. Your chats and notes stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hide your active status
patches.description: Stops people from seeing Active now for you while you use Instagram. You still see when they're active. Ghost mode, at the top of Ads and privacy, turns it on with the others. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Hold for 2x on feed videos
patches.description: Press and hold a video in a feed to play it at 2x with Instagram's own speed-up, and let go for normal speed, or keep it at 2x until you hold it again (every hold, or only one of about 3 seconds). The name over the video can stay put while you hold. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Home header text
patches.description: Puts words of your own, or a picture, at the top of Home in place of Instagram's logo. Nothing changes until you set one in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: HushGram launch screen
patches.description: Shows HushGram's logo instead of Instagram's on the screen you see while Instagram starts, on Android 13 and newer, and can fill that screen with your accent color. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: HushGram settings
patches.description: Adds a HushGram settings page to Instagram. Open it by long-pressing the Instagram logo at the top of your feed or Instagram's icon, or from the top of Settings and activity. Turn features on or off there, pause HushGram and save diagnostics. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Install next to Instagram
patches.description: Installs this build as a second Instagram beside your normal one, with its own data and sign-in. Pick its package name and app name in the patch's options, and whether its icon gets a HushGram badge. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

options.description: The second Instagram's package. Each part starts with a letter, with dots between the parts, and it can't be Instagram's own.
The name under the second Instagram's icon. It starts with a letter and holds up to 50 characters.
Puts a small HushGram badge on the second Instagram's home screen icon, so the two are easy to tell apart. Instagram's other icons you can pick in its settings get it too.

patches.name: Jump a profile's posts to a date
patches.description: Puts a calendar on a profile's top bar. Pick a day and the posts grid goes back to that day, with older posts as you scroll. Pull down for the newest again. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Keep HDR on photo uploads
patches.description: Lets an Ultra HDR photo you post keep its HDR gain map on Android 14 and newer. Experimental. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Keep Home's top bar
patches.description: Keeps the Instagram logo and the buttons beside it at the top of Home while you scroll. A second switch shows your feed blurred under them. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Keep Reels auto scroll on
patches.description: Keeps Instagram's auto scroll in Reels turned on after you leave Reels or restart Instagram, until you turn it off yourself. It can also move on to the next reel when one ends on accounts where Instagram doesn't offer auto scroll. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep a seek bar on Reels
patches.description: Keeps a seek bar under every reel, short ones too, with the time played and the reel's length above it, like 0:10 / 0:55. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep in chat
patches.description: Keeps view once and replayable photos and videos in your chats after you open them, so they don't disappear. A photo or video you send stays Instagram's own sent bubble. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Keep online history
patches.description: Keeps a list on your phone of when people in your messages came online and went offline, from the active status Instagram already shows. Nothing extra is asked of Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Keep photo locations from Instagram
patches.description: Stops Instagram from reading where the photos and videos in your gallery were taken. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Keep playing in the background
patches.description: A video or reel playing with sound keeps going when you leave Instagram or turn the screen off, with a notification to pause or stop it. Two more switches play reels or stories in a small window when you leave instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Keep stories playing while zooming
patches.description: Keeps a story playing while you pinch to zoom it, instead of pausing it. A story you hold still first stays paused. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Keep story buttons below the story
patches.description: With a large font or display size, the reply box and buttons along the bottom of a story move down into the empty space under it instead of covering the story. Starts on. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Keep story viewers
patches.description: Keeps a list on your phone of who viewed each of your stories, from the viewer list Instagram already shows you, and sets it beside your followers. It can also put a search bar back on that viewer list. Nothing extra is asked of Instagram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Keep the Reels top bar
patches.description: Keeps the Reels title, the Friends tab and the buttons beside them at the top while you swipe through reels. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep the reel speed
patches.description: Keeps the 2x speed on for the next reels after you lock a reel at 2x (hold its edge, then slide down), until you slide the lock off. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep the tab bar on a reel's profile
patches.description: A profile you open from a reel stays on the tab you're on, with the tab bar under it. Back goes back to the reel. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep the tab bar on reel links
patches.description: A reel link you open from another app plays on the tab you were on, with the tab bar under it. Back goes back to that tab. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Keep your place in Home
patches.description: Coming back to Instagram leaves Home on the post you were on, however long you were away, instead of reloading it and jumping to the top. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Let the screen sleep when a reel stops
patches.description: Instagram keeps the screen on while Reels is open, even with a reel paused. With this on, a paused reel lets your phone's screen timeout run, and a playing one keeps the screen on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Lock your messages
patches.description: Covers your inbox and chats, all of Instagram, or just the single chats you pick under Locked chats, until your fingerprint, face or screen lock says it's you. Message notifications only say that a message came. Chats you pick under Hidden chats leave your inbox and their notifications don't post. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Long press to zoom
patches.description: Press and hold a photo in a feed to see it twice as big around your finger, and let go to close it. Pinch to zoom still works. Keep the zoom open leaves it up after you let go, to drag and pinch from 1x to 4x until a tap or Back closes it. Long press a post for full screen opens any photo or video on black instead, a video with a slider. While its switch is on, each takes the place of Instagram's own long press. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Loop a story
patches.description: Plays a story again from the start when it ends, instead of moving on to the next one. Tap or swipe to move on. With it off, Loop this story in a story's menu loops just that one. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Mark one-time photos and videos
patches.description: Puts a border and Instagram's own view once icon on a one-time photo or video in a chat, so you can tell it before you open it. Only how the chat looks changes. Nothing is saved, replayed, marked seen or sent. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Message box buttons
patches.description: Lets you take the gallery, sticker and voice message buttons off the message box of a chat, and keep the text box and Send. Starts with every button showing. Pick which to hide in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Open comments without the keyboard
patches.description: Comments open with the keyboard down. A tap in the comment box, or on Reply, still brings it up. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Open links in external browser
patches.description: Opens web links you tap in your usual browser instead of Instagram's built-in one, without Instagram's click tracker. Ads and Meta's own sites (Instagram, Facebook, Messenger, Threads) still open in the app. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Open reel links on that reel
patches.description: A reel link opens on the reel it points to, instead of another reel Instagram kept on your phone playing first. Starts on. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Phone layout on big screens
patches.description: On a foldable or tablet, Instagram keeps its phone layout across the whole screen, with the tab bar at the bottom instead of down the side. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Pick the app icon
patches.description: Lets you pick the icon Instagram shows on your home screen: Instagram's own, HushGram's, Instagram's glyph on black, on plum, or in black on white, a hand-drawn Instagram glyph on white, Instagram's gradient glyph on dark, the old retro camera icon, or Instagram's glyph in pink on pale pink. The new icon shows once you leave Instagram, and you may need to add it to your home screen again from the app drawer. Starts on Instagram's own. Pick one in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Pinch to zoom on Reels
patches.description: Lets you zoom into a playing reel with two fingers, the way a photo zooms. Lift your fingers and it goes back. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Preview chats
patches.description: Long press a chat in your messages and tap Preview to read its newest messages without opening it, so nobody sees Seen. You can reply from there too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages. Either way, a chat's menu opens above the chat when it wouldn't fit between the chat and the tab bar.

patches.name: Profile posts as a list
patches.description: Opening someone's profile takes you on to their posts as a scrolling list of full posts. Back shows the grid. Your own profile keeps its grid. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Pure black dark mode
patches.description: Makes Instagram's dark mode pure black instead of dark gray, on the menus that slide up from the bottom, the one you get by holding a message or a chat, the one the + in a chat opens, and the notes above your chats too. It looks deeper and can save battery on an OLED screen. Buttons keep their grays so they stay easy to see. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Read messages without the seen receipt
patches.description: Opening a chat no longer tells people you've seen their messages. You still see when they've seen yours. Mark as read, or the check mark at the top of a chat, still tells them. With `Choose Seen in each chat` on, an eye at the top of each chat holds or sends Seen in that chat alone, whichever way the main switch is. Ghost mode turns it on too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Record calls
patches.description: Adds a record button to the call screen that saves the call's sound, both sides, to your phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Reels on Home below the name
patches.description: Shows reels on Home like other posts, with the name and the three-dot menu above the whole video instead of on top of it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed and Reels.

patches.name: Remove build expired popup
patches.description: Stops Instagram from locking you out with a screen that says this version is too old. A patched build can't update itself, so it would stop working after a few weeks. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Version warnings.

patches.name: Remove the advertising ID
patches.description: Stops Instagram from reading your phone's advertising ID, which ad companies use to follow you between apps. Instagram gets a string of zeros instead. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Remove the empty space at the bottom
patches.description: Takes away the empty gap Instagram leaves under its tab bar for a navigation bar that isn't there. Restart Instagram to see the change. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Layout.

patches.name: Restore trust on re-signed builds
patches.description: Lets Instagram's own checks of who signed the app pass on a patched build, so the parts that need them keep working. Threads, Facebook and Messenger patched with the same key work too. Facebook login goes through your browser instead of the Facebook app, which turns a patched Instagram away. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Resume long videos
patches.description: A video or reel longer than two minutes picks up where you left off the next time you play it on the same account. Live videos and ads start as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Rounded post corners
patches.description: Rounds the corners of a post's photo, video and carousel pages in Home and Following, and of reels and stories if you like, at a small or large size. Profiles and Explore stay as Instagram draws them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Run without Play services
patches.description: Keeps Instagram from closing right after you sign in on a phone without Google Play services, such as one with microG. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes tracking tags from the links you copy or share, and opens bio links without Instagram's click tracker. The link still opens the same post, reel, story or profile. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Save comment photo
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu you get by pressing and holding a comment that has its own photo, GIF or sticker, saving the largest size Instagram sent. A GIF or sticker is saved as a .gif in Pictures/Instagram, taken from Instagram's own copy, not Giphy. If Instagram lists only an animated WebP or an MP4 for it, you get that file instead, and an MP4 goes in Movies/Instagram like a video. It can also add a GIF reply to a comment with a GIF, sending that same GIF back as your reply, or show a comment GIF's or sticker's name in that menu. A GIF it saved, picked again from your gallery in a comment, goes up animated instead of as a still. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: Save in the post menu
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu behind the three dots on posts in your feed, and switches that take the Save button, the Like button, the counts or the "Liked by" line off them. Starts off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Save profile picture
patches.description: Adds Save profile picture, View profile picture, Copy username and Copy bio to the menu on someone's profile. View opens the picture full screen and lets you zoom. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Downloads.

patches.name: Saved on your profile
patches.description: Adds a bookmark to the tabs on your own profile, beside posts, reels and tagged, that opens Saved on All, a handle to drag through Saved and your collections, and switches that hide the + for a new collection, Saved's Reels tab and the Saved bookmark on the Search tab. The same handle can run down Home and your chats. All start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Profiles, Feed and Messages. The bookmarks need an Instagram restart.

patches.name: Search blocked accounts
patches.description: Adds a search box above your blocked accounts that finds them by username or name. While you type, the rest of your list loads page by page, and a line under the box says how many matched out of how many loaded. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Search comments
patches.description: Adds a search box above a post's comments. Type a word or a name and the comments scroll to the next one that has it, loading more as they go. The arrows step forward and back through the matches. Replies you haven't opened aren't searched. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Comments.

patches.name: See who a story mentions
patches.description: Adds a small label in a story's header showing how many accounts it mentions. Tap it for a list and tap an account to open their profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Seek bar on feed videos
patches.description: Shows a bar along the bottom of the video playing in your feed that you can drag to jump to any point in it. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed. Another switch there adds a small button on the video that shows or hides the bar, and a choice under it makes the bar see-through or puts it on frosted glass. Another puts the bar right on the video's bottom edge, where a scroll is less likely to catch it. One more lets a double tap on the left or right side of the video go back or ahead 10 seconds, while the middle still likes the post, and the arrows it flashes can be turned off. Two more choose a shape for every seek bar, story progress segments and videos in chats included, and show a preview above your finger while you drag one. Feed videos can also get a shape of their own, and the time over the bar, which a tap flips to the time left. The time can sit in the video's top corner instead, under Instagram's countdown.

patches.name: Seek bar on stories
patches.description: Shows a bar near the bottom of a video story that you can drag to jump to any point in the video. Photos don't get one. A choice under it makes the bar see-through or puts it on frosted glass, and another moves it into the space under the Send message box. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Sent follow requests
patches.description: Keeps a list of the accounts you've asked to follow that haven't let you in yet, with their pictures and names. A tap opens the profile, where Instagram's own Requested button cancels the request. It lists the requests a follow button shows while it's on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Shorter Active now
patches.description: Someone shows as Active now for one minute after they leave, like on the website, instead of six and a half. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Show a post's exact time
patches.description: Shows the date and time a post went up, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. It does the same for comments. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Show a reel's exact time
patches.description: Adds the date and time a reel was posted under the author's name, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, with the seconds or how long ago (1d 2h 5m ago) if you want them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Show a story's exact time
patches.description: Shows the date and time a story was posted, like Oct 2, 3:45 PM, instead of how long ago. A choice under the switch can show the time left instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Show all recent searches
patches.description: Lists every recent search under the search bar instead of the first few. See all and the x on each row work as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Explore.

patches.name: Show hidden like counts
patches.description: Shows how many likes a post or reel has when its owner hid the count, as long as Instagram's server still sends the number. If it doesn't, nothing changes. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Show if a profile follows you
patches.description: Adds Follows you or Doesn't follow you beside the name on someone's profile. Other switches add a chip and mark accounts on your Following list that don't follow you back, in words or as a red cross on the profile picture with a green check for those that do, and Recent unfollowers shows who left your Followers list, with a Follower history of who left, came back or is new. Holding a follow list's tabs can show only its public or private accounts, and your own lists can show since when each follow started, counted from when you turn that on. The chip is blue for Follows you, green for Following each other and red for Doesn't follow you, and it can go small under the profile picture. Tap the chip to see the rest of what Instagram says about you two, like Close Friends, Favorites, mutes, restrictions and pending follow requests. On by default. Turn it off in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Show when someone was last active
patches.description: Shows the exact time someone was last on, like Active at 3:42 PM, in your messages and in a chat, instead of Active 3h ago. Active now stays. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Skip the ad data reminder
patches.description: Stops Instagram's reminder to review whether it can process your data for ads from opening by itself. Your ad choice doesn't change and nothing is answered for you. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Skip the collections tray
patches.description: Saving a post or reel shows Instagram's Saved message instead of the tray that asks you to start a collection. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Skip the contacts and location popups
patches.description: Stops the screens asking you to sync your contacts and turn on location services from opening each time Instagram starts. Nothing else is skipped. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Smooth story opening
patches.description: Opens a story from the stories row with a slower, gentler zoom instead of Instagram's quick spring. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Sort reels on profiles
patches.description: Brings back the arrow next to Reels on a profile, with Latest and Most viewed, on profiles where Instagram took it away. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Profiles.

patches.name: Speed button on stories
patches.description: Puts a speed button at the top of a video story. Tap it to play the story at 1.5x or 2x, and later video stories keep that speed. Photos and ads play as usual. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Split the notes row
patches.description: Splits the row of notes at the top of your messages into three stacks, Instants, Notes and Stories, the layout Instagram is trying out. It takes a restart. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Messages.

patches.name: Spoof location
patches.description: Tells Instagram your phone is at a place you pick, for the location sticker, nearby places and maps. Photos keep their own places. You need to pick a place too. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Ads and privacy.

patches.name: Start Home on Following
patches.description: Opens Home on posts from accounts you follow instead of For you. A second switch removes For you from Home, and a third keeps Instagram's logo at the top of Home in place of the feed's name. A fourth, Fall back to Following, opens Home on Following for an account whose For you brings only suggested posts, unless you picked a feed. A fifth, Mix in Following, shows a page of posts from accounts you follow after each page of For you. Restart Instagram to see the change. Keep the tab bar on Favorites leaves Search and Messages a tap away there, and a tab you choose can open Favorites with a long press. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Start feed videos with sound
patches.description: Starts videos on Home with their sound on, the same as tapping a video's speaker, and a photo post's song too, or keeps videos muted while reels play with sound. Your phone's ringer and volume still count, unless `Even on silent` under it is on. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Feed.

patches.name: Start on x86 devices
patches.description: Stops Instagram from crashing or freezing on x86 devices that run its code through a translator, such as some Chromebooks and emulators. Phones and tablets with arm chips run it as before. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Start reels with sound
patches.description: A reel you open from the Reels tab, a profile or a post on Home plays with sound, and Home is muted again when you go back. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. A separate switch, Start reels muted, starts every reel silent instead. Both start off. Turn them on in HushGram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Start stories with sound
patches.description: Opens stories with their sound on, the same as tapping Instagram's speaker. Your phone's ringer and volume still count. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Stop Reels scrolling
patches.description: Stops a swipe in Reels from moving to the next reel, so you stay on the one you opened, with switches that leave reels from a profile, Search and Explore or a song page free to scroll. Play only the reel you opened does the same, auto scroll included, for reels you open from a post on Home, a suggested reels row or a message, and leaves the Reels tab alone. Another switch stops swiping after as many reels as you pick, for as long as you pick, and Take a scroll break covers Home, Reels and Explore for 5 minutes after the time you pick. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Reels.

patches.name: Stop Story auto-advance
patches.description: Keeps each story on screen until you tap or swipe. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Stories.

patches.name: Stop background wake-ups
patches.description: Stops three things that wake your phone while Instagram is in the background. One alarm goes off every minute or two only to note that Instagram is still running, another wakes it five minutes later to upload usage events, and a job about every half hour downloads your feed ahead of time. Messages and notifications still arrive. Starts off. Turn it on in HushGram settings > Battery.

patches.name: Stop swipe to create
